svg.metadata: Ferrosift investor review v01; model-derived HLR and solid sections; geometry mm; A3 landscape; Full-width capture and review routing
svg.text: Repaired collection geometry / one proposed airjet split plus downstream balance-window gate / no measured flow claim
DISCHARGE SIDE / selected solids, protective shell omitted / 1:10
DISCHARGE PLAN / physical chute and collection layout / 1:15
Dashed balance/review paths are alternatives; all paths are intent, not measured trajectories.
The 660 mm concentrate inlet spans the nominal 600 mm belt and converges to a 260 mm outlet. Sidewalls provide a
physical narrowing path; they do not prove friction, rebound, bridging or recovery. Jet impulse and delay remain test
A 660 mm catch converges to the 136 mm gate approach. The upstream-pointing blade is shown in transition position:
no feed permitted. Inhibit feed, drain, command and verify gate position before resuming. See sheet 10.

Review routing may include neighbouring pieces and cannot recover an unknown already ejected into concentrate. Chute bounce prevents exact item-time assumptions. Feed inhibit and a normal review bin are not certified safety functions or battery
DIMENSIONS: mm | SCALE: PER VIEW AT A3 | DO NOT SCALE FOR MANUFACTURE
Preliminary study geometry. Proposed inspection targets on sheet 8 are unapproved; no load, sensing or safety rating.
